mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling consumer spending (RSAFS) together signal a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is rising and RSAFS is falling.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% over 3 months) increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates strong economic activity and corporate hiring, boosting earnings expectations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1200 thousand units) signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A falling industrial production (INDPRO) and falling consumer spending (RSAFS) together signal a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate output and revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is falling and RSAFS is falling.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 3% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches its peak, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 3% annualized.
